decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Site Location Plan received 23/06/2011 and 002 and 003 received 23/08/2011) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings to the minimum extent possible.

Condition : 4 - In the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands shall be retained to show the historical past of the building. Supporting beams shall be retained, and if changed because of rot, shall remain visible as a downstand. The nib shall have a minimum depth of 0.2m.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until details showing the size, design, materials and proportions of the proposed replacement door including sectional details at a scale of 1:20 have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be completed in accordance with these approved details unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority beforehand.
description: Replacement of rear door with double doors and internal alterations
